<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Add optional node-sharded Mooncake storage for Engram tables through one
model-independent adapter shared by DeepSeek V4.1 Engram and Qwen4-Exp PLE,
including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next checkpoints.

## Claims

- Assign complete hash heads to storage nodes independently of TP, ETP, and DP
  compute ranks, while preserving each model's existing collectives,
  quantization, and prefetch behavior.
- Publish only node-owned rows through Mooncake
  `EngramStore.populate_shard_and_sync`, then perform local and remote lookups
  through one stream-ordered byte interface.
- Use vLLM's dense local worker rank as the default Mooncake `caller_id`, rather
  than the process-visible CUDA ordinal.
- Keep store references alive through model-runner teardown, then close them in
  deterministic namespace order after CUDA graphs have been released.

## Validation

The caller-ID regression was reproduced against the previous PR head
`a2d7c04d4c`: a focused test configured vLLM local rank 2 and CUDA ordinal 7,
and failed with `assert 7 == 2`. The same test passes with this change.

Commands and results on Machine 70's existing vLLM environment:

```bash
python -m pytest -q tests/model_executor/layers/test_mooncake_engram.py -k 'not cuda'
# 6 passed, 1 deselected

python -m pytest -q tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_engram_mooncake.py -k 'not cuda'
# 1 passed, 1 deselected

python -m pytest -q tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_ple.py -k mooncake
# 2 passed, 129 deselected

python -m pytest -q tests/test_config.py -k mooncake
# 3 passed, 514 deselected
```

Ruff check/format, Python compilation, `git diff --check`, Buildkite step-key,
test-tethering, SPDX-header, and lazy-import checks pass. The new common and
DeepSeek tests are tethered to the CPU Basic Models CI step.

A focused CUDA smoke on NVIDIA H20-3e passed for compute-head slicing,
DeepSeek packed E4M3FN + ue8m0 decoding, and Qwen ETP ownership masking with
raw FP8 row preservation.

The complete pre-commit wrapper could not bootstrap its first hook environment
on Machine 70 because the GitHub clone stalled; the applicable checks listed
above were run directly. A full two-node serving run against the real Mooncake
#5129 backend is also pending, so this PR remains a draft and no model-eval or
end-to-end performance claim is made.

## Details

### Design and compatibility

The adapter receives a model's head layout and byte-row encoding. DeepSeek
keeps TP head ownership, TP gathers, FP8/ue8m0 decoding, and side-stream
prefetch. Qwen keeps ETP vocabulary ownership, DP/ETP collectives,
sequence-parallel behavior, prefetch, and downstream quantization; its global
FP8 scale remains outside Mooncake rows and is applied exactly once by the
existing PLE layer.

`caller_id` defaults to `get_world_group().local_rank`, which remains dense
when one-GPU worker processes each see CUDA device 0. Explicit caller mappings
remain supported and are range-checked. Shutdown uses the common GPU worker
entry used by both model-runner versions: it captures attached stores before
runner teardown, releases model graphs, and then closes stores in the same
namespace order on every worker.

This implementation requires the node-sharded API from
[Mooncake #5129](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5129) after the
[large-local-table offset fix](https://github.com/magicYang1573/Mooncake/pull/1)
has landed in that branch. The fix prevents 32-bit offset overflow for local
tables larger than 2 GiB, including common Qwen PLE layouts. Authenticated
masters use `MC_METADATA_HTTP_TOKEN`.

### Duplicate-work check

The open [#64082](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64082) shares
already host-resident DeepSeek Engram tables across independent instances, and
[#64500](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64500) prefetches CPU-offloaded
DeepSeek rows. Neither provides node-sharded local/remote Mooncake lookup or
Qwen PLE support. [#57872](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57872)
uses Mooncake for KV-cache P/D transport and does not overlap this table-storage
path.

The placement contract matches
[SGLang #47673](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47673): contiguous
whole-head node ownership, model-load publication, per-node storage shards,
per-GPU callers, and preserved compute parallelism. The vLLM adapter is shared
by DeepSeek and Qwen rather than being Qwen-specific.

### Configuration and limitations

```json
{
  "local_dir": "/mnt/nvme/mooncake-engram",
  "shard_id": 0,
  "num_shards": 2,
  "master_addr": "http://10.0.0.10:5000",
  "session_id": "deployment-2026-11-04",
  "max_lookup_rows": 65536,
  "rdma_device": "mlx5_{local_rank}",
  "num_callers": 4
}
```

`max_lookup_rows` counts token/head IDs. Mooncake placement is an alternative
to `disk_offload`, `dp_shared_memory`, `use_thp`, and `embedding_across_dp`.
Pipeline parallelism, elastic EP, and Qwen NVFP4 PLE rows remain unsupported.

description. The human submitter must review and be able to defend every
changed line before requesting review.

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Mooncake-backed immutable row storage shared by Engram model families."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _load_mooncake_config(path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load the deployment options accepted by Mooncake EngramStore."""
+    try:
+        options = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid Mooncake Engram config {path!r}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(options, dict):
+        raise ValueError("Mooncake Engram config must be a JSON object")
+
+    allowed = {
+        "local_dir",
+        "shard_id",
+        "num_shards",
+        "master_addr",
+        "session_id",
+        "caller_id",
+        "max_lookup_rows",
+        "rdma_device",
+        "timeout",
+        "num_callers",
+    }
+    if unknown := options.keys() - allowed:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown Mooncake Engram options: {sorted(unknown)}")
+    required = {
+        "local_dir",
+        "shard_id",
+        "num_shards",
+        "master_addr",
+        "session_id",
+        "max_lookup_rows",
+        "num_callers",
+    }
+    if missing := required - options.keys():
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing Mooncake Engram options: {sorted(missing)}")
+    if not isinstance(options["local_dir"], str) or not options["local_dir"]:
+        raise ValueError("Mooncake Engram local_dir must be a nonempty string")
+    for name in ("shard_id", "num_shards", "max_lookup_rows", "num_callers"):
+        if type(options[name]) is not int:
+            raise ValueError(f"Mooncake Engram {name} must be an integer")
+    if (
+        not 0 <= options["shard_id"] < options["num_shards"]
+        or options["max_lookup_rows"] < 1
+        or options["num_callers"] < 1
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid Mooncake Engram node shard or lookup capacity")
+    for name in ("master_addr", "session_id"):
+        if not isinstance(options[name], str) or not options[name]:
+            raise ValueError(f"Mooncake Engram {name} must be a nonempty string")
+    if "caller_id" in options and (
+        type(options["caller_id"]) is not int
+        or not 0 <= options["caller_id"] < options["num_callers"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Mooncake Engram caller_id must be in [0,num_callers)")
+    if "rdma_device" in options and (
+        not isinstance(options["rdma_device"], str) or not options["rdma_device"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Mooncake Engram rdma_device must be a nonempty string")
+    if "timeout" in options and (
+        type(options["timeout"]) not in (int, float) or options["timeout"] <= 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Mooncake Engram timeout must be a positive number")
+    return options
+
+
+def _head_shard(
+    head_sizes: tuple[int, ...], num_shards: int, shard_id: int
+) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+    """Return owned head and concatenated-row bounds for one storage node."""
+    if not head_sizes or any(size <= 0 for size in head_sizes):
+        raise ValueError("Mooncake Engram requires positive head sizes")
+    if num_shards > len(head_sizes):
+        raise ValueError("More Mooncake node shards than Engram hash heads")
+    head_begin = len(head_sizes) * shard_id // num_shards
+    head_end = len(head_sizes) * (shard_id + 1) // num_shards
+    row_begin = sum(head_sizes[:head_begin])
+    row_end = sum(head_sizes[:head_end])
+    return head_begin, head_end, row_begin, row_end
+
+
+def pack_mooncake_rows(*planes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pack same-row CPU tensors into EngramStore's byte-row representation."""
+    if not planes:
+        raise ValueError("At least one Engram row plane is required")
+    rows = planes[0].shape[0]
+    if any(plane.device.type != "cpu" or plane.shape[0] != rows for plane in planes):
+        raise ValueError("Engram row planes must be same-length CPU tensors")
+    byte_planes = [
+        plane.detach().contiguous().view(torch.uint8).reshape(rows, -1)
+        for plane in planes
+    ]
+    return byte_planes[0] if len(byte_planes) == 1 else torch.cat(byte_planes, dim=1)
+
+
+class MooncakeEngramStorage:
+    """One model layer's node-sharded EngramStore deployment."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config_path: str,
+        *,
+        namespace: str,
+        head_sizes: tuple[int, ...],
+        row_bytes: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not namespace:
+            raise ValueError("Mooncake Engram namespace must be nonempty")
+        if row_bytes <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Mooncake Engram row_bytes must be positive")
+        self.options = _load_mooncake_config(config_path)
+        self.head_sizes = head_sizes
+        self.row_bytes = row_bytes
+        self.head_begin, self.head_end, self.row_begin, self.row_end = _head_shard(
+            head_sizes,
+            self.options["num_shards"],
+            self.options["shard_id"],
+        )
+        self.names = tuple(f"head{index}" for index in range(len(head_sizes)))
+        num_shards = self.options["num_shards"]
+        num_heads = len(head_sizes)
+        self.owners = {
+            name: ((index + 1) * num_shards - 1) // num_heads
+            for index, name in enumerate(self.names)
+        }
+        self.offsets = tuple(
+            sum(head_sizes[:index]) for index in range(len(head_sizes))
+        )
+        self.namespace = namespace
+        self._store: Any | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def local_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.row_end - self.row_begin
+
+    def initialize(self, rows: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Publish this node's owned heads and connect every storage shard."""
+        if self._store is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Mooncake Engram storage is already initialized")
+        if (
+            rows.device.type != "cpu"
+            or rows.dtype != torch.uint8
+            or rows.shape != (self.local_rows, self.row_bytes)
+            or not rows.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Mooncake Engram initialization requires contiguous CPU uint8 "
+                f"[{self.local_rows},{self.row_bytes}] rows"
+            )
+
+        try:
+            from mooncake.engram import EngramStore
+        except ImportError as exc:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Mooncake Engram requires the node-sharded API from Mooncake #5129"
